Residents:
Felix (30s) and Aisha (40s) work in town offices. Weekdays: out ~08:00–17:30, home evenings. Weekends: sleep in, errands midday, home rest of day. Felix hobbies: family calls, knitting, movies. Aisha hobbies: family calls, movies, houseplants, running.

Balcony: Floor has watering can. Table has spray bottle, gardening gloves.
Bathroom: Shelf has detergent, laundry basket. Med cabinet has Aisha’s meds, Felix’s skincare/toiletry bag, Aisha’s skincare. Coffee table has candle, coasters, tissues, remote, board game, Aisha’s glass, Aisha’s mug, serving dish, snack bowl, Aisha’s phone, Felix’s tablet. Couch has blanket, cushion 1, Felix’s knitting bag. Side table has lamp. TV stand has remote. Floor empty.
Office: All spots empty.

Notes:
Weekend routine differs from weekdays. On Saturday, both residents remained home from 00:00 to 16:00. At 08:00, Felix took his phone out of the house (likely for errands), returning it by 16:00. By 16:00, they had moved work items (laptops, chargers, headphones, notebooks) to the bedroom desk, suggesting preparation for remote work or organization. Kitchen items (bowls, mugs, plates) were moved from cupboard/sink to the kitchen table at 16:00, likely for a meal. Aisha’s skincare moved to the medicine cabinet. Friends visited in the evening, causing shared items (board game, serving dish, snack bowl) and Aisha’s drinkware to move to the coffee table. Felix’s phone was on the nightstand at 00:00, then gone at 08:00, and back on the nightstand by 16:00. Aisha’s phone moved to the coffee table at 00:00.
